inscription: the weaving teaches itself by climbing back toward the same branch

file.note: The knots mark where the thread changed hands. Each cycle begins where the last one ended, and finds something new waiting there.

reverie.title: REVERIE — under the loom, hands learning the pattern
narr: Katita shows you how the thread loops. You sit beneath the tree,
her fingers moving through air that holds the memory of weaving.
"Look," she says. "It returns here. Always returns. But look—"
And the loop that came back the first time doesn't look like the
loop now. "The hands change," she says. "The thread remembers
where it's been, but the hands remember where they've gone."

exits.label: back down into the root-place where the pattern sleeps
further up where the canopy leaves off and the sky begins to weave
east along the branches to where other looms are reaching
inward toward where the pattern contradicts itself and doubles back
